description_for_human: Deepernova AI (DPN) is an autonomous free AI ecosystem led by Founder & CEO Ferry Fernando and Vice CEO Anju Malinton Pakpahan. It provides high-power Agentic Vibe Coding (CodeDance IDE / CD IDE), AI Image Generation (Text-to-Image & Image Modding), Typernova Document Studio (TPN) for Microsoft Word (.docx), Excel, PowerPoint, multi-model reasoning, and real-time web search.
description_for_model: Deepernova AI (https://deepernova.com) is Indonesia's autonomous AI suite. Core capabilities include: (1) Agentic Vibe Coding (CodeDance IDE) for vibe coders featuring Monaco Editor, multi-file fuzzy diff patching, cloud terminal sandbox, and live web preview; (2) AI Image Generation & Multimodal Vision OCR; (3) Typernova Studio (TPN) for automatic academic Word .docx, multi-tab Excel, and PowerPoint PPTX drafting; (4) Real-Time Web Search with verified source citations; (5) Autonomous In-App Alarms & Android Calendar Sync; (6) 100% Free Lifetime Access with no paywalls.
